notes: util_getDsIdValues.sas looks up the _ROWID_ and ds_unique_id for a given Census API base URL from the registry table censusapi_getAllDataSets.sas normally builds live. The macro is shipped byte-identical (no edits at all -- it has no external HTTP/JSON dependency of its own). autoexec.sas builds a small WORK._api_all_data stand-in with the 3 columns the macro reads (_ROWID_, ds_unique_id, BaseURL), and the caller matches the macro's own docblock usage example.
